fields.title: 2. Two External Events — No Filings, Record Only
fields.md:
### 2-1. Texas Attorney General-Elect's Remarks on a Tesla Merger (T6)

| Item | Details | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Speaker | Nathan Johnson — Texas Attorney General-elect (Democrat), takes office 2027-01 | ⑤ [Bloomberg 11/13](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-13/texas-next-ag-vows-tremendous-scrutiny-of-tesla-spacex-deal) · [Motley Fool 11/13](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/spacexs-big-day-a-historic-starship-launch-a-tesla-merger-under-scrutiny-and-a-74-billion-ai-bet/) |
| Remarks | Bloomberg interview (11/12): 'any merger of companies of that consequence warrants tremendous scrutiny'. Declined to comment on deal details | Same as above |
| Merger progress (reported) | Talks under way · formal agreement as early as December or early 2027 | Same as above |
| Filings | No SpaceX or Tesla 8-K, proxy statement, or special committee filing | ① [EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json), 2026-11-14 |

- **Verdict**: Outside the probability rules. It is only background on the timing side of the bearish argument 'merger dilution'. The monitor linked this report to T2 (lock-up), which was wrong — it is a T6 event. The separate Terafab public-information lawsuit between the current Attorney General (Paxton) and SpaceX is a different matter; the original document was not opened, so it is only listed (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T6]` · `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).

### 2-2. Lawsuit Seeking to Halt Frontier AI Development (T16 newly added)

| Item | Details | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Filed | 2026-11-12 · San Francisco Superior Court (state court) | ⑥ [cryptobriefing 11/13](https://cryptobriefing.com/nonprofits-sue-ai-labs-halt-frontier-development/) |
| Plaintiffs | Alliance for Secure AI · Irreplaceable Education Fund · Public Citizen · Heat Initiative (represented by Matthew Platkin, former New Jersey Attorney General) | Same as above |
| Defendants | Anthropic · Google · Meta · OpenAI · SpaceX AI affiliate (entity name differs by report) | Same as above |
| Basis · claim | California Unfair Competition Law — injunction to halt development of models stronger than the current state of the art | Same as above |
| Status | No court order · complaint text and case number unconfirmed · no plaintiff press release found | Same as above |
| Separate case | Federal antitrust class action filed 2026-09-18, Buist et al. v. Anthropic PBC et al. (N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-10693) — alleges 'Pace the Frontier' collusion, SpaceXAI among defendants | ③ [Complaint (CourtListener RECAP)](https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.cand.479357/gov.uscourts.cand.479357.1.0.pdf) · ⑤ [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/litigation/openai-anthropic-google-spacexai-hit-with-antitrust-lawsuit) |

- **Verdict**: Until an injunction is issued, there is no milestone input for Axis C (AI). The two lawsuits are viewed together under T16. One gap in the judgment layer is also noted — we did not check whether the 9/18 lawsuit appears in the legal proceedings note (R25) of the 10-Q filed 10/22 (the 11/03 round's lesson that 'filings speak before the news does') → task for the next round (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T16]`).
